title: Infant girl with whooping cough
summary: A short Mayo Clinic clip of an infant in intensive care with severe whooping cough, held by her mother. It shows the baby's violent coughing.
why: Used in vaccination arguments to show what pertussis does to infants too young to be vaccinated.

quote.text: I want you to watch a video of an infant, too young for vaccination, that has contracted whooping cough
